explanation: Fires only at D1, and only when the previous trial was rewarded after reaching S1 (normally a1 with a common transition), at about 7-8 on the first such win after a loss and 9-10 after two or more S1 wins in a row; it is weaker later in the episode (about 3-6 after trial 60), and about 2 when S1 was reached by a2 through a rare transition. It is 0 at every GO and D2 step, at D1 after a loss, and at D1 after any reward collected in S2.
